title: Mornington Racecourse Monthly Market, June 2026
summary: Monthly market at Mornington Racecourse featuring handmade crafts, fashion, fresh produce, art, and artisan goods. Runs second Sunday of the month year-round. June 2026 edition noted on Shire markets page.
accessibilityNotes: Some flat racecourse areas; check for pram access to stall layout
weatherDependency: Moderate, outdoor; postponement policy not stated
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Main Street; Port Phillip Bay; Mornington Pier
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with a walk along the Mornington esplanade and lunch on Main Street
editorVerdict: Winter doesn't kill this one: the racecourse keeps the second-Sunday rhythm going while Red Hill is in hibernation.
editorNote:
The June edition is the standard 9am to 2pm format at Mornington Racecourse. Crafts, fashion, fresh produce, art and artisan goods, same second-Sunday rhythm as the rest of the year. This is the off-season Peninsula market that earns its keep.

The move: wrap warm, arrive by 9:30am, do food and coffee first, then a Mornington esplanade walk and Main Street lunch to fill the afternoon. Verify the time slot before driving: occasional twilight editions (3pm to 8pm) appear in other months.
